ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio (~3:1) between dominant high-intensity white/light-gray background and low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated in the central and medial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation forms a bi-lobed, roughly symmetrical butterfly-shaped pattern originating from the central notch. Numerous secondary dark pixel clusters (mottling) and elongated streaks are distributed laterally across both lobes, with higher frequency on the left lobe's mid-section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 45-50 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency serration along the entire continuous boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly at the distal tips, showing irregular, jagged vertical displacements of 20-40 pixels from the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral upward sweep following a concave-to-convex transition; the inner portion of the trailing edge is concave relative to the notch, while the outer margin follows a jagged convex curve toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast ring-like feature on the right lobe (mid-right quadrant) consisting of a dark perimeter and lighter center. High-density, textured pixel clusters (white/gray) are localized at the terminal tips of both lobes, representing barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct linear pixel disruptions. Multiple parallel horizontal rake marks are visible on the left lobe (center-left); vertical and diagonal unaligned scratches are present across the medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) visible on both lobes; heavy bio-fouling/barnacle colonization on the distal trailing edges; multiple circular scars consistent with focal surface trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The distal tips of the fluke exhibit a highly fragmented and irregular pixel boundary, appearing significantly more eroded or traumatized compared to the central trailing edge.
